briefs.title: Balanced Keeper
briefs.summary: Find the most complete all-around candidate without sacrificing stability for one flashy trait.

briefs.title: Resin Scout
briefs.summary: Prioritize resin expression and stability while keeping enough vigor and structure to remain practical.

briefs.title: Aroma Keeper
briefs.summary: Chase standout aroma, but do not ignore stability, resin, and the plant frame supporting the expression.

briefs.title: Outdoor Frame
briefs.summary: Favor vigor, branching structure, stability, and useful yield potential over cosmetic traits.

briefs.title: Fast Finisher
briefs.summary: Choose for speed without letting the rest of the keeper profile collapse around one early finish trait.

briefs.title: Production Workhorse
briefs.summary: Prioritize vigor, useful structure, yield potential, and stability for a dependable all-purpose plant.
